verdict.rationale: Oyster is a hosted HR and employer-of-record SaaS platform, so asking whether it can be self-hosted is a fair question. The evidence shows only a hosted API, embeddable web components, webhooks and vendor-provided developer sandboxes. Nothing documents a self-hostable or on-premises deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
